nodes.name: BaseChessAgent
nodes.docstring: Abstract interface for AI chess agents in ChessMind Arena.

nodes.name: GroqChessAgent
nodes.docstring:
AI Chess Agent powered by Groq LLMs.
Requests structured decision summaries using JSON mode and strictly enforces legal chess moves.

nodes.name: MockChessAgent
nodes.docstring:
Deterministic AI Chess Agent for testing, CI, and mock mode demonstrations.
Does not require Groq API key or network access.

nodes.name: ConnectionManager
nodes.docstring: Manages WebSocket subscriptions per game_id for real-time telemetry streaming.

nodes.name: BoardManager
nodes.docstring:
Authoritative chess board manager using python-chess.
Maintains official state, legal moves, history, PGN, and contextual summaries.

nodes.name: MoveQualityClassifier
nodes.docstring:
Classifies chess moves based on engine evaluation change and centipawn loss.
Calculates moving player perspective metrics.

nodes.name: StockfishEvaluator
nodes.docstring:
Independent Chess Evaluator and Referee.
Uses Stockfish UCI engine when available, with a robust heuristic fallback
to guarantee zero crashes in all environments.

nodes.name: select_move
nodes.docstring:
Receives current board state and returns (ChessDecision, telemetry_dict).
telemetry_dict contains: latency_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, move_source.

nodes.name: extract_json_from_text
nodes.docstring: Extracts JSON object from response string, handling markdown code fences if present.

nodes.name: _select_emergency_move
nodes.docstring: Selects a sensible legal move that avoids hanging material.

nodes.name: list_models
nodes.docstring: Returns available Groq models dynamically discovered or catalogue.

nodes.name: list_personalities
nodes.docstring: Returns preset agent personalities with system instructions.

nodes.name: compare_models
nodes.docstring: Returns comparative performance metrics across all models from historical games.

nodes.name: create_tournament
nodes.docstring: Creates a new 4 to 6 AI model tournament with custom participants and bracket.

nodes.name: list_tournaments
nodes.docstring: Lists all tournaments with summary metadata.

nodes.name: get_tournament
nodes.docstring: Retrieves full details of a tournament: bracket matches, participants, standings, live board FEN, and report.

nodes.name: start_tournament
nodes.docstring: Starts or resumes autonomous execution of tournament matches.

nodes.name: pause_tournament
nodes.docstring: Pauses autonomous tournament match execution.

nodes.name: delete_tournament
nodes.docstring: Deletes a tournament and its state.

nodes.name: get_game_result
nodes.docstring:
Returns (winner, termination_reason).
winner: 'white', 'black', 'draw', or None if game is ongoing.

nodes.name: apply_move
nodes.docstring:
Applies a validated legal chess.Move to the board.
Returns (san_move, uci_move, new_fen).

nodes.name: get_material_summary
nodes.docstring: Returns piece counts and material balance.

nodes.name: get_recent_history_text
nodes.docstring: Returns recent moves formatted cleanly as move pairs (e.g., 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 d6 ...).

nodes.name: generate_pgn
nodes.docstring: Generates standard PGN string for the game.

nodes.name: get_tactical_context
nodes.docstring:
Extracts rich tactical signals from the board to dramatically boost LLM awareness:
- Forcing moves (checks, captures) vs quiet moves
- Pieces currently attacked by opponent, highlighting hanging/under-defended pieces
- Direct king safety state (is in check, can escape/block)

nodes.name: check_move_safety
nodes.docstring:
Simulates move on a temporary board to verify whether the piece was moved
onto an attacked square without sufficient defense (blundering a piece).
Returns (is_safe, warning_message).

nodes.name: calculate_cpl_and_quality
nodes.docstring:
Calculates centipawn loss (CPL) and assigns move quality label.
eval_before and eval_after are normalized to White advantage (in pawns).

nodes.name: calculate_accuracy
nodes.docstring:
Calculates overall game accuracy (0% to 100%) from a list of CPL values.
Uses a smooth exponential decay formula similar to modern chess analytics platforms.

nodes.name: detect_critical_moment
nodes.docstring: Detects if a move constituted a critical inflection point in the game.

nodes.name: identify_opening
nodes.docstring:
Identifies the opening name based on the sequence of moves.
Returns opening name or 'Unknown / Custom Position' if not matched.

nodes.name: evaluate_position
nodes.docstring:
Evaluates a position given by FEN.
Returns:
    {
        "score_white": float,       # Normalized score in pawns: + White, - Black
        "score_cp": int,            # Centipawns from White perspective
        "mate": Optional[int],      # Mate in N (+ White, - Black)
        "best_move_uci": str,
        "best_move_san": str,
        "depth": int,
        "is_engine": bool
    }

nodes.name: _evaluate_heuristic
nodes.docstring:
Positional and material heuristic evaluator used when Stockfish binary is not running.
Evaluates material, piece placement, king safety, and mobility.

nodes.name: validate_fen
nodes.docstring:
Validates a chess FEN string using python-chess.
Returns (is_valid, error_message).

nodes.name: validate_move
nodes.docstring:
Validates whether a move string (UCI or SAN) is legal for the current board state.
Returns (is_legal, move_obj, error_message).

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.docstring: Initializes tables in database.

nodes.name: get_db
nodes.docstring: FastAPI Dependency for database session.

nodes.name: compute_game_analysis
nodes.docstring: Computes comprehensive game analytics and persists GameAnalysisModel.

nodes.name: _run_game_loop
nodes.docstring: Background autonomous turn-by-turn game loop.

nodes.name: execute_next_move
nodes.docstring:
Executes a single turn for the active player.
Returns True if game ended after this move, False otherwise.

nodes.name: get_comparison_stats
nodes.docstring: Aggregates performance metrics across historical games grouped by model.

nodes.name: classify_move_heuristics
nodes.docstring: Determines secondary or fallback strategies deterministically from chess geometry.

nodes.name: resume_active_tournaments
nodes.docstring:
On server startup, scans for any tournament marked as 'running'
and restarts the execution loop if it's not already executing.

nodes.name: _advance_bracket
nodes.docstring: Populates downstream matches in the bracket tree.

nodes.name: _generate_tournament_report
nodes.docstring:
Creates a deep, clear, user-facing analysis of the tournament.
Covers champion crowning, model performance, accuracy comparison,
tactical dynamics, and prompt recommendations.

nodes.name: cleanup_mock_test_games
nodes.docstring: Ensure test mock games never linger in database.
